explication: Ciphey is a library-first tool that searches for decoding paths and identifies likely plaintext; the CLI is one interface to the library. Its principal workflow accepts text, selects decoders, runs them under a search strategy, checks candidate output, and presents results. The repository also documents timeout handling, configurable and enhanced plaintext detection, multilevel decoding, statistics, and custom themes. Some relationships and capability implementations are based on README or source-index references; unsampled code is not treated as inspected.
